class.name: SteamCommerceRequest
class.brief_description: One pending result owned by a game commerce operation.

method.name: complete_catalog
method.description: Completes this exact catalog request on the main thread. Repeated or retired completions return an error.

method.name: complete_order
method.description: Completes this exact order request on the main thread. Confirm the order through the game backend before responding. Repeated or retired completions return an error.

signal.name: catalog_completed
signal.description: Emitted once when the catalog request settles.

signal.name: order_completed
signal.description: Emitted once when the order request settles.
